name: fts_phrase

test_list.description: fts_phrase("hello world") is the single FTS5 phrase "hello world".
Every embedded double quote becomes two, so the phrase can never be closed early.
NUL characters are dropped from both the FTS phrase and the LIKE pattern (SQLite would truncate at NUL).
like_pattern escapes %, _ and the escape character itself and wraps the text in %...%.
proptest: for any input the phrase starts and ends with a quote and every inner quote is part of a doubled pair.

output_description: A single FTS5 phrase (or LIKE pattern) with no operator semantics.
